name: DlightRAG · the collector refused telemetry
message: the collector refused or failed to take in telemetry; this window saw {{value}} records. a refusal is back-pressure or a batch it could not read, so check the collector's own metrics before the pipeline goes quiet.

chartConfig.name: collector refused or failed records
chartConfig.sqlTemplate:
SELECT sum(greatest(delta, 0)) AS refused_or_failed_records
FROM (
  SELECT MetricName,
         Attributes['receiver'] AS receiver,
         max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta
  FROM otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName IN ('otelcol_receiver_refused_spans', 'otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records', 'otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points',
                       'otelcol_receiver_failed_spans', 'otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records', 'otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points')
    AND $__timeFilter_ms(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY MetricName, receiver
)
